notes.title: NEW LANGUAGE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/683f4640428d386d4ebf6db8d446537747a936b9.png[/img]
[h3]Hi, everyone! Didn’t see that coming, huh?

While our team is working on a new game and preparing more and more content, we thought... Why not make it so that [b]even more[/b] players have the chance to play Horny Warp?

Because of that, we decided to add another new language to the game - Polish! Big thanks to [b]Sadisticu [/b]for work on the localization! We hope you all will enjoy it and, as always, share your feedback.

And if you want the game to be localized to your language, be sure to write a comment about it!

Thank you for staying with us,
Luminati Games team.[/h3]

tags.feature: Because of that, we decided to add another new language to the game - Polish!

notes.title: MORE LANGUAGES!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/a13453f7903849ca21d0779c3663189c367c0808.png[/img]
[h3]You voted, and we delivered! Now even more players can enjoy "Horny Warp" in their native language. Many thanks to [b]Mauro Amoroso (Spanish)[/b] and [b]Antonie P (French)[/b] for the wonderful work. We hope everyone will be satisfied, and don't forget to share your feedback with us.

Thank you for your patience,
Luminati Games team.

P.S. Our team has started working on a [b]new[/b] game, details of which we will be able to share with you soon. [b][url=https://twitter.com/LuminatiGames]So stay tuned in![/url][/b][/h3]

tags.feature: Now even more players can enjoy "Horny Warp" in their native language.

notes.title: STEAM TRADING CARDS HAVE ARRIVED!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
[h3]After a short break, we're back with gifts for you. Hooray! Trading cards for everyone! For many, this won't be a surprise because the cards will immediately appear in the inventory if you have enough playtime in "Horny Warp".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/17b0f878ebd7e584d332977899211057614bff7f.png[/img]

Also, the addition of trading cards is not the only thing that happened. We have also prepared for you:
[list]
[*]Beautiful animated backgrounds (non-animated backgrounds are also available)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/53242ce99d6b6c846cfb1d4aedea5b554b19cbe0.gif[/img]

[*]Emoticons that we specially drew for this occasion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/5a19dce33165a8d717bb57bddb831ef5cb248a68.png[/img]

[*]And of course, badges! Yes, everyone's favorite girl is in the foil badge.😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/dc2eeaef80ffbe6f20cada0b419915688de72276.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]And the good news doesn't end there! Thanks to oRyyi, "Horny Warp" is now available in Portuguese.[/h1]

Oh, we almost forgot!
Although we didn't make it in time for the spring sale, spring isn't over yet! So we're offering a [u][b]20% DISCOUNT[/b][/u] on "Horny Warp" to celebrate the release of the trading cards

Have fun collecting Community Items! Thanks to your interest in "Horny Warp", we were able to create these cards. [b]Thank you all so much![/b]
[/h3]

notes.title: UPDATED RELEASE DATE AND DEMO UPDATE OF "HORNY WARP"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/3a31c6c4df814e0910330a7fa11f786f7a362c3d.png[/img]
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
[h3]We will start this devlog with the news about delaying the release of “Horny Warp.” If previously we set the release somewhere in January, then now we are ready to announce the exact release date - [u][b]February 17[/b][/u]. [/h3]
Of course, the game will release somewhat later than you expected, but our team needs the time to finish the game without compromising its quality. We are sure you also share our wish for “Horny Warp” to release at its best, and that's why we believe you will understand our decision. To make everyone happy, however, we have prepared a surprise!

[b]We have updated the demo for “Horny Warp”.[/b] You will get one more minigame and the first H-scene with priestess Lilyan. This will help you get a better feel for the game and pass the time until its full release. 
[b]We have also prepared the Mac OS build![/b] Now every owner of Mac OS devices will be able to play the “Horny Warp” demo. The final version of the game will also be compatible with Mac OS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/fca6c5bdeddaad9c0c34fc81b0baef3ac7e58cbb.png[/img]

And there's even more good news!
Lately, “Horny Warp” has received an enormous amount of support and attention. This greatly inspired our team, and we have plans to support the game for a long time to come. 
[b]We are going to add one H-scene and one side story for every girl![/b] We won't give any details before the release of the main build, though. Our first priority is releasing “Horny Warp,” and the additional content comes second. 

[h3]We would like to apologize again for the release delay. Anyway, you won't be waiting for long![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1539160/Horny_Warp_Hentai_Fantasy/

[h3]Thank you for your interest in our game! Don't forget to wishlist the game and follow.
With love, Luminati Games.[/h3]
